about: WP22b S1 keep-or-drop measurements on the 2026-10-27 machine (Apple M3 Pro, 12 cores, 36 GiB, macOS 26.4.1). process_pairs: two release CLI binaries that differ by one change, the same command, 31 runs each (11 for builds, 5 for why) after two discarded runs each, p50 nearest-rank; '-seq' entries ran each binary's runs back to back, the others alternated. 'bw-final' is the S1 build at 1e3ca7f (C2 still in); each 'bw-no-X' is that build with change X reverted (patch in the pull request description); 'bw-c12', 'bw-c123', 'bw-c1234' are 7238ca8 plus C1-C2, C1-C3, C1-C4. load is the 1-minute load average at the end of the case. criterion: the median and its 95% interval from criterion's estimates.json, the before binary run with --save-baseline before and then the after binary with --save-baseline after.
